castAddBody.text:
$1000 FOR NETWORK STATE VISUALS

Make fully open-source visuals of how a network state forms. Reply with your submission, the tools you used, and links to the raw files.

$500 grand prize, $100 honorable mentions. Seven days.

$1000 Prize for AI Conference Organizer

Build an open-source AI slide validator: check a deck's file format, run deterministic checks and AI prompt checks, and show pass or fail. Add an organizer dashboard that merges accepted decks.

Open source, seven days.

Cloud Cartography: $1000 Prize

Build an open-source, mobile-friendly tool that visualizes the social network among a chosen set of Farcaster users over time, with metrics on a slider.

Seven days to submit.
